verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs say you can "run scenarios at the touch of a button to assess different assumptions" in workforce planning, which covers creating scenarios such as a hiring wave. Nothing in the evidence shows comparing scenarios side by side, or modelling a slipped quarter or downside case specifically; variance analysis against budget is a related but different feature. missing for 10: documented side-by-side scenario comparison, evidence of scenario creation beyond the workforce use case (e.g. revenue or downside cases), independent or hands-on corroboration.
